reviews.text: BAH is the best, I wouldn’t take my cat or dog anywhere else. Yesterday Dr. Karan saw my cat Sebastian for yearly check up and shots. Dr. Karan and the vet took such good care of Sebastian. BAH treats me and my animals like family I wouldn’t go anywhere else. Shout out to Dr. Brett and the rest of the staff also, I’ll never forget how you treated Jake my dog that had lymphoma. When another vet said Jake would be dead in a week, Dr. Brett treated Jake and we were able to spend another 9 months with him. I am eternally grateful to you guys for treating Jake and giving us those 9 months with him.
Dr Brett and his assistant Jocelyn were amazing! This was our first time here and he was great! I highly recommend Blvd animal hospital!

Dr. Brett, Dr. Patel, and the staff are amazing. They will treat and care for your animals as if they are their own. That in itself provides an immense amount of comfort whether it’s for a routine check-up or an emergency.
Have gone to dr Brett for years! He treats us like family and I couldn’t imagine going anywhere else
Thank you Alan!

I can’t thank Dr. Karan and his team enough for taking such great care of my 14-year-old dog during his dental procedure. At his age, I was understandably nervous, but Dr. Karan made me feel comfortable and confident that he was in good hands.

The procedure went wonderfully, and seeing Choka back home and acting like a young dog again has made me so happy! He has his energy and personality back, and it’s amazing to see the difference in him.

Dr. Karan was caring, professional, and clearly very knowledgeable. I’m incredibly grateful for the care he provided to Choka and would absolutely recommend him to anyone looking for someone they can trust with their pet. ❤️🐾

We have been coming here for many years, for our current dog and prior dogs and cats. Originally with Dr Jerry Geffen, and his wife Ellen in the office, and now their son, Dr Brett Geffen.  The vets and technicians are always professional,  friendy, and very talented. We trust them for all of our animal care needs, and including flea and tick medications. A highly recommended veterinary practice, who always provide excellent service.
Thank you Hope!
Care for Sophie’s gastrointestinal issues
Dr Jeffen and Dr Karan are a dynamic team. Our dog Phillip is treated with kindness, love and dignity every visit. I have recommended this vet many times and will continue too!

Dr. Brett has a vibrant sanguine warm personality that immediately puts both pets and their owners at ease. Their knowledge, compassion, and professionalism create an environment where I always feel confident that my fur babies are receiving the very best care. I truly appreciate the time and attention they give to every visit, and I couldn't ask for a better veterinarian.

Dr.Brett and his staff have always been amazing,so helpful in scheduling for our Siberian husky and so kind to the entire visit from beginning to end.Thank you so much for making our husky feel better today.Dr.Brett is so caring,thank you for your help!

I would ever take my pet there. They told me she needed special diet cat food. Took her to another vet she was very sick to find out she had an infection in her kidneys and UTI. They treated her for month now she is much better. They never took the time to proper  diagnosis her.
Thank you Lisa!

First time here. I brang my cat. Dr. Patel is super nice. The staff are super nice. Left feeling at ease and thankful for everyone at this office. I will most definitely come back. Great Animal Hospital to bring your animal.

Been a patient of Brett’s for close to 30 years and 4 dogs. Service has always been excellent, appointments are quick, and care for euthanasia was heartfelt,  compassionate and caring. Highly recommend Brett Geffen.

Dr Geffen is great. My Puff is older now, 13 yrs old. I wanted her to have a full check up cause she's losing muscle mass. Took blood. Gotta take her back for a urine test when wr get other cats teeth removed. He said to just bring her in at end of day. I did have an issue over the wknd after dr visit. Puff started hiding, not sleeping with me. I knew something was wrong. She has an on going problem with left sinus & ear clogging. I have to put drops in several times a week. I couldn't get the drops down. Her nose was completely blocked. I called on Monday. They said to just bring her by to give her a dose of antibiotics. The next morning, my fur baby was running to eat, and followed me around all day. She was bqck to normal.

I brought in 4 newborn kittens that the mom abandoned. They were malnourished and still had afterbirth on them. I tried taking them to Paws down the street. They turned me away. As I entered Boulevard Animal Hospital, I was immediately greeted with open arms. They rushed the kittens back to care for them. Unfortunately 1 didnt make it, but they said the other 3 are going to be OK. Thank you, so much, you all were so wonderful.  Reach out to me if there's anything you all need.
Dr. Brett and his staff are professional, compassionate and knowledgeable. We have been using this practice for many, many years and would recommend to anyone!
Always a great experience with Dr Brett Geffen and team. They are professional, accommodating, informative, and friendly.

Have been to many vets in the area for  pittbull doggies this place was extremely amazing and caring! Our dogs took to the staff so well and made the whole process so easy for once. Casey, Shauna and Dr. Karan were so professional and great with the dogs, we will be back for all of our dog needs. Thank you so much
Great staff, very knowledgeable and caring.

Dr. Brett ‘s expertise and compassion were evident throughout our visit. He took the time to thoroughly examine my pet patiently, answered all of my questions and provided clear explanation about the diagnosis and treatment options. It is not often you find a vet who combines such high levels of knowledge with a warm approachable demeanor.
Highly recommended
Wonderful experience as always. Are pets have been treated by Dr. Brett and his staff for over 25 years. The quality of care is excellent and I would highly recommend Boulevard Animal Hospital.
Thank you for your 5 star review Paul!
Dr Bret is fabulous and I trust him completely.

Brett has been my vet for atleast the last 15 years and he truly is the best. He’s been with my family since I was young with our family animals and now with my own animals as an adult. He truly is the best and always has taken such good care of my animals even in their last moments. Brett created such a great team at boulevard animal hospital I trust them with everything and anything ❤️

Dr. Brett has been caring for our Boxer for 8 years and highly recommend him. The entire staff is caring and welcoming, especially Buster's best friend Shauna. Dr. Brett has helped us thru joint surgeries, illnesses, and most recently Cushing Disease. My family can not say enough good things about all of the staff there.

I have been using the Geffen family for more than 40 years ever since Bret’s father opened up the clinic.  Over the years we have been  extremely satisfied with the care and treatment of our pets. I would highly recommend this clinic if you really care about your prts
Love my doctor Brett and Molly does too
We had a great experience with the doctors and staff at Boulevard Animal hospital. Everyone was friendly and took great care of our pup!
I Have been Bringing my dogs  here for 32 years. I wouldn’t go anywhere else. But my dogs are worth it🐾 …

Dr Brett is amazing with my dogs and always gives them the most amazing care. He is compassionate, knowledgeable and always available when needed. His staff is awesome, and always go the extra mile to make you and your pet feel comfortable!
Best Veterinary Hospital ever! I've been a client for 17 yrs. They have saved many of my pets. The Doctor s and Nurses are awesome!

My dog and cats all go to Boulevard Animal Hospital and they love it. The staff give expert care while treating the animals with the upmost care and love. I would recommend anyone taking their pets here!
Friendly and welcoming staff. Took great care of my fur baby.
Great vet always friendly doctors and staff been going here for years.

Dr. Brett And his staff are the best!!!

I would never go anywhere else.  I always have the best experience and they always treat my cats and dogs as if they are their own.

Thank you so much for everything!

We will never go to another vet.

kind and caring staff, took good care of my kitty. im not sure what the benchmark is for how expensive a vet visit is compared to others but i paid about $320 for treatment. my cat had a deep infectious wound, which caused her a lot of pain. her wound was cleaned and drained. she was blood tested and vaccinated. they took great care of my cat, and answered all my questions. im satisfied with the visit and was glad i was able to be seen promptly. ♥️♥️♥️best staff

Had never been to this vet before however, when I called for my cat who I suspected had a UTI, they had me come right away! Everyone was so professional and extremely kind, my new vet hands down! Thank you Boulevard Animal Hospital! I might add that their fees for services were reasonable.

I have been going to Boulevard Animal  Hospital for over 27 yrs. I moved from the area over 3 yrs ago and travel over an hour for visits. I have tried other Vets in this area but I was not happy with there service. I am confident in knowing that my pets are getting exceptional care with Dr Brett Geffen and his team. All my pets have lived a long, healthy and happy lives with my oldest pomeranian being 18 yrs old. Dr Brett is caring and very knowledgeable, he takes the time to explain everything and is current with the newest meds and test. His staff is very pleasant always a smile, gentle and caring with my pets. I highly recommend Dr. Brett Geffen and his team at Boulevard Animal Hospital, they are the Best

Dr. Brett, Dr. Karan, and the entire staff at this vet clinic are very knowledgeable, always kind, helpful, and compassionate. They treat pets with the utmost patience and kindness, which is why I’ve continued to bring my cats here for care even after moving out of Philadelphia seven years ago.

I also love the positive work environment they’ve created. You can tell that the staff genuinely enjoys working there. I highly recommend them!
Dr.Karam is so sweet and was so good with my Lola.
Boulevard Animal Hospital has taken care of my pets for over 20 years. BAH provides the best care for your pet and treats you like family! The entire office staff is absolutely amazing!
Thank you Dawn!

We recently had to Euthanize our boy. We wanted to do it at home but could not afford it. The employees at Boulevard Animal Hospital made a terrible experience bearable. Everyone of them were so understanding and compassionate. They did not rush us. They showed love and respect for our boy. He even got to eat chocolate for the 1st time. I can never thank them enough for their empathy. They helped so much to ease our pain.

We’ve been bringing our cats to Boulevard Animal Hospital for about five years and have always had great experiences. Brett and his staff (including Melvin, the resident cat, who always makes the visit a little less stressful) are kind and gentle with our cats, pricing is fair, appointments are available when needed, and follow-ups are thoughtful and helpful. We trust them and highly recommend this clinic.

After moving away from Northeast Philly and trying several vets downtown, my family realized there is simply no one like Dr. Brett  and his team. We now happily make the commute back to Boulevard Animal Hospital because the level of care here is unmatched.
Our history with this practice goes back well over 20 years; we originally started with Dr. Brett’s father, Dr. Jerry Geffen,taking our first dog Max. It is a special family practice with a long legacy, and that tradition of excellence has been passed down to his one-of-a-kind son, Dr. Brett.
They don't just treat your "animal kids"; they care for the humans, too. My 70+ (years young) mom was recently frustrated with other vets downtown who charged hundreds of dollars for treatments that didn't help our 13-year-old dog, Lulu. Since returning to Boulevard, we finally have peace of mind. Dr. Brett and the fantastic new Dr. Kuran actually listen to us. They never push unnecessary services and will even talk to my mom over the phone to decide if a drive is truly necessary.
Dr. Kuran even shared how much he has learned and is encouraged to succeed under Dr. Brett’s mentorship. As a daughter, knowing that my mom and Lulu are treated with such kindness and respect—even when I can't be there—is a huge relief. We are so lucky to have them! Thank you!!!

I have been taking my pets to Boulevard Animal Hospital for over 20 years. This should already tell you something, specifically that a small family business has lasted this long, as such, they are doing something right. You get personalized service from Dr. Gefen and other vets there, and the entire staff is super friendly, helpful and treats your pet as if it were their own. Unlike the franchise type vet clinics, the prices for services here are much better while still having all the resources and knowledge as the other "corporate" clinics. If you want a great experience, affordable prices, excellent care for your pet(s) and personalized service, then this is the place for you. I have experienced this for over 20 years.

I have been taking my fur babies to BAH for over 25 years. Dr Brett & the team are fantastic. They are always professional, knowledgeable, accommodating and courteous and there is no where else I’d consider going. Highly recommend them.

I hate to say this but I just left one establishment after 25 years because of their staff not the doctor! It seems just after one phone call it would be the same situation here so I will stay away even though for 20 years we used Jerry senior even watched him on TV many years ago . Brett was a child then. nothing is the same anymore even with animals, it's a shame.. I hope he's not too big headed and loves what he does because his staff doesn't
Been a patient of the Geffens for nearly 30 yrs with different dogs. Always been great with our dogs. Kept them healthy, and h aed them when necessary!! 5 stars not enough!!!

The care our pets receive is excellent.
Dr Brett and Dr Kuran (spelling?) and the Vet assistants are terrific.
There are many vet hospitals closer to us but we have been taking our dog to Boulevard Animal Hospital for over 10 years.  The staff is attentive, friendly, and always eager to help.

Brett and his staff are wonderful! My husband and I have been taking our three dogs for years and love it. Brett and his staff go above and beyond for our dogs. I highly recommend anyone to take their animals to see Brett and his staff!

Boulevard Animal Hospital is the best of the best! They’re the only place I trust taking my babies to! I’ve been bringing them here for many years now. If you’re looking for a place to take your animals that you can trust, feel completely comfortable with, and know that they will treat them as if they were their own, then I highly recommend them!!

I have been going to see Dr. Brett for over 20 years and he has always been amazing to all of my dogs! His staff goes above and beyond to accommodate any needs that I have! I wouldn’t trust anyone else with the care of my five pups!

If you’re looking for a new vet look no further!!! I have been coming to dr Brett for quite a few years now, and I have always been very happy with the staff and the treatment and care they provide for my animals. Just when I thought they were a great vet office….. they recently became our heroes!!! A few weeks before Christmas we took our 3 year old Benny to the hospital and they thought he’d just injured his back, but by that night he was completely paralyzed. The next day our options were $12,000 or more for surgery or put him down. We were totally heartbroken 💔I decided to wait until Monday to bring him to see dr Brett and ask his advice on how to move forward. He and the staff were so sad to see this happen that he decided to put him on crazy amounts of medication and started him on laser therapy treatment. He said  I have to at least try to save him, let’s cross our fingers and pray for the best. Well now we are 6 weeks in and coming every day for therapy and Benny is starting to stand and walk. He may never be the same pup, but he’s alive and I am forever grateful to Brett, dr Karan and all the staff. I cannot recommend this office enough!!! 🩷🩵🩷🩵🩷🩵this office!!!

I’ve been doing to Boulevard Animal Hospital since 2004, when I took on my first cat.  Brett Geffen and his staff are wonderful, and they’re cared for all my pets for over twenty years . Can’t recommend them enough.

Brett and his team have been taking care of all my animals for the last 20 years. They are so accommodating with any requests I have and let me bring my dogs through the back and right into a room,
so we don’t have to sit in a waiting room which I appreciate so much! I will continue to trust Brett for years to come!!!
They took such good care of my Mooch❤️😻 …

I do recommend this animal hospital. When I need to take my cat here, for a sickness appointment, I usually can get an appointment, fairly quickly. Dr. Brett Geffen, is very thorough, will take time explaining his diagnosis to you, and is very friendly, and down to earth doctor. The staff is friendly, and is accommodating, to meet your needs,in terms of answering questions, and concerns, you may have. You can book appointments, online as well.

During my interaction, the staff was extremely unprofessional and dismissive. When I asked to speak with an office manager, the front desk associate casually stated that the manager had passed away last year - which was an inappropriate and insensitive response.

Additionally, a stray dog was brought into the clinic, and rather than following proper legal and ethical stray-hold procedures, a veterinary technician decided to take the dog home personally. This is highly concerning, as any found animal should be processed through a licensed stray-hold facility to ensure due diligence in locating potential owners.

Just because someone works in a veterinary office does not automatically make them qualified to determine ownership or bypass standard protocols.

For these reasons, I would strongly recommend finding another veterinary facility that upholds professionalism, compassion, and proper animal welfare procedures.

I’ve been going to Boulevard Animal Hospital before Brett was even a vet. I was going to his father always received outstanding care and service for my animals and every time I needed them in an emergency they accommodated me Brett is the best and so is his staff I would take my animals nowhere else when they’re sick.

The staff and vetrinanrians there are phenomenal. They are very kind, respectful, and caring. They are really passionate about helping animals and show every member of your family with respect and care. I highly recommend everyone go there for their pets!
Very caring group of Doctors and staff.

Dr Brett and his whole staff are simply amazing! I just started taking my kitten here & I'm so glad I did. I had a scare with my kitten and they were so quick to get me in. My Odie was a tad nervous getting blood work done but he was so calm the whole time & that is because they are gentle & kind! The vet tech Shauna is also the best & Odie really loves the cuddles he gets from her when we go in! Best vet around!
Love Dr Brett!

This is a very cozy and cute place, and the staff are absolutely fantastic. The doctor is also very professional while still being friendly. My little kitty was very comfortable during the appointment because the staff are so patient and friendly. Seen incredibly quick and the prices are very reasonable. I found my new regular vet! 😁 …

Freddie referred me to a place that provided my baby gentle care made such a difference in in my life and family.  I am forever grateful for the warmth and support and HUGS you extended to all of us!

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for all that you did for Kobe's family and for being there for us during this transition and difficult time. Your kindness will never be forgotten.

With heartfelt appreciation,
Love always KOBE Dad and his Liceaga family!
